why_ai: MD relationships win mandates and licensed bankers negotiate consequential deals; AI compresses analyst production.
why_clarity: Process shape repeats, but price achieved has no counterfactual and closes months later.
why_digital: Financials and documents on screens; pitches, management meetings and negotiations largely in person.

why_ai: Lenders put capital at risk on each credit decision, sourced through sponsor relationships.
why_clarity: Credit memos follow a standard shape, but loan performance resolves over years.
why_digital: Target financials analysed on screens; deals sourced through sponsor relationships.

why_ai: Named testifying economists face adversarial agency and court scrutiny that AI cannot carry.
why_clarity: Each merger review is bespoke; agency or court decisions arrive within months.
why_digital: Client data analysed on screens; testimony delivered in person, hired through counsel.

why_ai: Expert witnesses testify personally under cross-examination in adversarial appraisal litigation.
why_clarity: Valuation methods are standard, but each case is unique and the court decides.
why_digital: Valuation analysis on screens; testimony in court, engaged through litigation counsel.

why_ai: Acquiring boutiques is high-stakes judgement about people and franchises, done through relationships.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is distinct and its success shows only years later.
why_digital: Financial analysis on screens; deals negotiated face to face with partners.

why_ai: Registration, examinations and enforcement are statutory authority that stays with regulators.
why_clarity: Exam cycles recur, but enforcement and guidance outcomes are contested and slow.
why_digital: Filings reviewed digitally, exams partly onsite; firms cannot choose their regulator.

why_ai: Ingestion, entity resolution and ranking automate; the firm's own process record is the moat.
why_clarity: Ranked buyer lists are checked against who actually bid in later processes.
why_digital: Process records and data room logs in, ranked lists out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Spreading and calendarisation are mechanical and peer selection is retrievable by AI.
why_clarity: Every pitch needs the same comps pages, though peer acceptance involves some judgement.
why_digital: Data terminals and filings in, valuation pages out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: The network's value is trusted member relationships for cross-border buyer access.
why_clarity: Shared deal lists recur, but referral value is relationship-dependent and slow to show.
why_digital: Deal lists shared online; trust built through member conferences and meetings.

why_ai: Platform position gives a data vantage, but market reports are automatable analytics.
why_clarity: Quarterly deal-flow forecasts are checked against later announced deal volumes.
why_digital: Platform activity in, reports and software out, entirely online.

why_ai: Covenant analysis automates, but breaking restructuring news relies on reporters' human sources.
why_clarity: Covenant and docket analyses follow standard formats on a constant flow of documents.
why_digital: Documents and dockets in, subscription intelligence out, entirely online.

why_ai: The opinion must survive Delaware cross-examination and the issuing firm carries the liability.
why_clarity: Analyses are standardised, but whether they hold up surfaces only in later litigation.
why_digital: Excel analyses on screens, presented in person to boards and special committees.

why_ai: Auditors require independent specialists, though PPA and impairment methods are codified and automatable.
why_clarity: ASC 805 and 350 methods are codified and the auditor reviews every assumption.
why_digital: Deal and financial data in, valuation reports out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Founders sell once and choose a banker on trust and referral to guide them through.
why_clarity: Preparation is repeatable, but closing at the headline price depends on each messy business.
why_digital: Tax-prepared records and site meetings feed a sale run largely in person.

why_ai: Pre-announcement deal intelligence comes from journalists' source relationships AI cannot replicate.
why_clarity: Each rumour later resolves as a deal or not, but reporting quality is ungraded.
why_digital: Sourced through conversations, published and sold as online subscriptions.

why_ai: Contested M&A recommendations need judgement, but proxy materials are public and readable by AI.
why_clarity: Recommendations recur each meeting and vote outcomes arrive on the meeting date.
why_digital: Proxy filings in, recommendations out, delivered online to investors.

why_ai: Member surveys are simple research; association standing and member network carry the value.
why_clarity: Surveys recur on a fixed cycle with a defined structure.
why_digital: Surveys run and published online; membership built through chapter events.

why_ai: Comps, profiles and pitch pages produced to template are directly substituted by AI.
why_clarity: Template-bound deliverables recur nightly and are checked by the deal team.
why_digital: Remote production of digital pages for banks abroad.

why_ai: Knowing which investors are deploying relies on relationships; matching and outreach automate.
why_clarity: The round fills or not within months, though each investor universe differs.
why_digital: Investor lists and materials digital; fundraising runs on meetings and relationships.

why_ai: Contributed private transaction multiples exist nowhere else, a moat AI cannot generate.
why_clarity: Quarterly databases are compiled the same way from contributed transactions.
why_digital: Contributed data in, reports and databases out, sold online.

why_ai: Buyers and lenders require independent QoE from recognised accounting firms, argued in re-trades.
why_clarity: Adjusted EBITDA, working capital and net debt follow defined methods, disputed later.
why_digital: Ledgers and working papers in, databooks and reports out, mostly remote.

why_ai: Adversarial multi-party negotiations under court oversight need trusted, accountable advisers.
why_clarity: Analysis follows established shapes, but every situation and recovery is bespoke.
why_digital: Documents and models on screens; negotiations and court hearings in person.

why_ai: Carriers bear deal-specific risk priced by former M&A lawyers, with claims emerging years later.
why_clarity: Underwriting reviews diligence the same way, but claims reveal mispricing slowly.
why_digital: Diligence reports and agreements reviewed on screens; policies placed through brokers remotely.

why_ai: Running an auction and negotiating the purchase agreement are relationship-led, high-stakes judgement.
why_clarity: The teaser-CIM-auction process is codified, but the best possible price is unknowable.
why_digital: Deliverables built on screens; management presentations and negotiations in person.

why_ai: Repeat sponsor sellers know buyers and run bake-offs, leaving less room for relationship value.
why_clarity: Repeated buyer universes and bids give observable evidence within each process.
why_digital: Polished data and processes on screens; bake-offs and meetings in person.

why_ai: Template-bound page production from MD markups is exactly what AI drafting automates.
why_clarity: Each page is correct and on template by morning, or it is not.
why_digital: Excel and PowerPoint work entirely on screens.

why_ai: Consistency checks and buyer status tracking are mechanical work software can own.
why_clarity: Numbers and statuses either match across model, CIM, data room and tracker or not.
why_digital: Data rooms, trackers and models managed entirely on screens.
